Code.description: Short code for the item (max 30 chars). Required on creation.

IsSold.description: Whether the item appears on sales transactions. Defaults to true.

Description.description: Text shown on invoices and quotes. Up to 4000 characters.

IsPurchased.description: Whether the item appears on purchase transactions. Defaults to true.

SalesDetails.description: Default pricing and account for sales.

TotalCostPool.description: Average cost value of current stock. Read-only.

COGSAccountCode.description: COGS ledger account. Mandatory when tracking inventory.

PurchaseDetails.description: Default pricing and accounts for purchases.

PurchaseDescription.description: Text shown on bills and purchase orders. Up to 4000 characters.

IsTrackedAsInventory.description: Whether stock levels are tracked for this item.

InventoryAssetAccountCode.description: Ledger account for holding stock value. Mandatory when tracking inventory levels.

Item.description: A product or service that can be referenced on invoices, bills, and other transactions. Items can optionally track inventory.

Phone.description: A phone number with type classification and optional area/country codes.

Quote.description: A proposal or estimate sent to a customer before a sale is confirmed. Can be converted to an invoice once accepted.

Name.description: Label shown in the ledger. Up to 150 characters.

Description.description: Explanatory text (max 4000 chars). Not available for bank accounts.

SystemAccount.description: System account designation (e.g., DEBTORS, CREDITORS). Read-only.

ShowInExpenseClaims.description: Whether this account appears in expense claim options.

EnablePaymentsToAccount.description: Controls whether the account can receive payment allocations.

Account.description: An entry in the chart of accounts representing a category for tracking financial activity (assets, liabilities, income, expenses, etc.).

AddressType.description: Distinguishes between mailing (POBOX) and physical (STREET) addresses.

Address.description: A postal or street address associated with a contact or organisation.

Name.description: Person or company name. Up to 255 characters.

Phones.description: Phone numbers by type: DEFAULT, DDI, MOBILE, FAX.

Balances.description: Outstanding and overdue amounts for receivables and payables. Read-only.

Discount.description: Standard percentage reduction applied to this contact's transactions. Read-only.

Addresses.description: Up to two addresses: one POBOX type and one STREET type.

TaxNumber.description: Tax identification number (ABN, GST, VAT, etc.).

IsCustomer.description: Automatically set to true when a sales transaction exists. Read-only.

IsSupplier.description: Automatically set to true when a purchase transaction exists. Read-only.

PaymentTerms.description: Default payment terms for bills and sales.

AccountNumber.description: Account number used for reference (max 50 chars).

ContactStatus.description: Whether the contact is active, archived, or flagged for GDPR deletion.

BankAccountDetails.description: Bank account info for payment purposes.

Contact.description: A customer, supplier, or other party involved in transactions. Contacts are automatically flagged as customers or suppliers based on transaction activity.

Url.description: Link back to the source document in an external system.

Type.description: ACCPAY for bills from suppliers; ACCREC for invoices to customers.

Contact.description: The customer or supplier. Required on creation.

Payments.description: Payments applied to this invoice. Read-only.

SubTotal.description: Sum of line amounts before tax. Read-only.

TotalTax.description: Computed sum of tax amounts across all lines. Read-only.

LineItems.description: Transaction lines with amounts, quantities, and account codes. Required on creation.

Reference.description: Supplementary identifier for sales invoices. Not available on bills.

InvoiceNumber.description: User-visible reference number (max 255). Auto-generated for ACCREC if omitted.

SentToContact.description: Marks the invoice as sent without actually emailing it.

BrandingThemeID.description: Branding theme to apply to the invoice layout.

FullyPaidOnDate.description: When the outstanding balance reached zero. Read-only.

LineAmountTypes.description: How tax is applied to line amounts.

Invoice.description: A sales invoice (ACCREC) or vendor bill (ACCPAY). Invoices track amounts owed and can be emailed, paid, voided, or deleted.

Amount.description: Payment amount in the invoice currency.

Account.description: The bank account used for this payment.

Invoice.description: The invoice this payment is applied to.

BankAmount.description: Converted value in the settlement account's denomination. Relevant for cross-currency payments.

PaymentType.description: System-determined type based on the associated transaction. Read-only.

IsReconciled.description: Whether this payment has been matched to a bank statement line.

Payment.description: A record of money received from a customer or paid to a supplier, applied against an invoice, credit note, or other document.

User.description: The employee who incurred the expense.

Receipt.description: A record of an expense incurred by an employee, typically attached to an expense claim.

TaxType.description: Identifier used to reference this tax rate on transactions.

TaxComponents.description: Individual tax components that make up this rate.

TaxRate.description: A named tax rate configuration including one or more component rates that can be compound.

Currency.description: A currency enabled for the organisation.

Employee.description: A person employed by the organisation. Used for expense claims and receipt recording.

TaxType.description: Tax rate identifier applied to this line.

ItemCode.description: Code of the associated item, if applicable.

Tracking.description: Up to two tracking category assignments for this line.

AccountID.description: Account UUID as an alternative to AccountCode.

TaxAmount.description: Tax calculated for this line. Read-only when auto-calculated.

LineAmount.description: Total for this line (Quantity x UnitAmount). Read-only when auto-calculated.

LineItemID.description: System-generated unique identifier for this line.

AccountCode.description: Chart of accounts code to post this line against.

Description.description: Text describing the goods or services on this line.

DiscountRate.description: Discount percentage. Only available on sales invoices (ACCREC).

DiscountAmount.description: Flat monetary reduction for this line. Applicable to ACCREC records and quotations.

LineItem.description: An individual line on a transaction such as an invoice, bill, or bank transaction.

Invoice.description: The invoice this allocation applies to.

Allocation.description: Links a credit note, overpayment, or prepayment to an invoice, applying a portion of the credit against the invoice balance.

RemainingCredit.description: Amount not yet allocated to invoices. Read-only.

CreditNote.description: A document that reduces the amount a customer owes (ACCRECCREDIT) or the amount owed to a supplier (ACCPAYCREDIT). Credit can be allocated against invoices.

Prepayment.description: An advance payment made before an invoice is raised. Cannot be created directly; arises from bank transactions. Can be allocated to invoices when they are issued.

Overpayment.description: An excess payment beyond what was owed. Cannot be created directly; arises from bank transactions. The surplus can be allocated to future invoices.

BankTransfer.description: A movement of funds between two bank accounts within the same organisation. Transfers are immutable once created.

ContactGroup.description: A named group for organising contacts into logical collections.

ExpenseClaim.description: An employee's request for reimbursement of out-of-pocket expenses, backed by one or more receipts.

BrandingTheme.description: A visual template applied to invoices, quotes, and other customer-facing documents. Read-only via the API.

IncludeInEmails.description: Whether this person receives email communications.

ContactPerson.description: An individual associated with a contact record, typically for multi-person organisations.

Narration.description: Descriptive text explaining the journal entry. Required.

LineAmount.description: Positive for debit, negative for credit.

JournalLines.description: Debit and credit lines. Positive LineAmount = debit, negative = credit.

ShowOnCashBasisReports.description: Whether this journal appears on cash-basis reports. Defaults to true.

ManualJournal.description: A manually created journal entry with debit and credit lines for adjustments and reclassifications.

PurchaseOrder.description: A document sent to a supplier requesting goods or services at agreed prices.

Type.description: Nature of the bank transaction. Required.

BankAccount.description: The bank account this transaction is recorded against. Required.

BankTransaction.description: A transaction recorded directly against a bank account, such as money received or spent.

TrackingCategory.description: A dimension for categorising transactions (e.g., department, region, project). Each category has a set of options.

LinkedTransaction.description: A link between a billable expense line on a purchase transaction and a sales invoice line, enabling pass-through billing.
